l4_steps.name: Extract layover schedule by station and date
l4_steps.input: Published crew pairings for 14-day rolling window
l4_steps.output: Layover demand matrix by city, date, and crew count
l4_steps.kpi: Schedule extraction latency <15 min after pairing publish
l4_steps.pain_point: Late pairing publication (T-24h or less) leaves insufficient lead time for contracted hotel vendors requiring 48-hr booking notice

l4_steps.name: Forecast hotel room demand by city
l4_steps.input: Layover demand matrix, historical IROPS uplift factors by station
l4_steps.output: City-level room demand forecast with IROPS buffer (typically +15%)
l4_steps.kpi: Forecast accuracy ≥90% vs actual bookings week-over-week
l4_steps.pain_point: IROPS surges at hub stations can exhaust all contracted room blocks within 2 hrs; forecast buffers are static and do not adjust to live weather events

l4_steps.name: Validate contracted block vs demand forecast
l4_steps.input: Room demand forecast, contracted block inventory by hotel and city
l4_steps.output: Block gap report flagging cities with coverage <95%
l4_steps.kpi: Contracted block coverage ≥95% of forecasted demand
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-hub IROPS events simultaneously exhaust blocks across 3–5 cities; no automated cross-city reallocation mechanism exists in current system

l4_steps.name: Auto-generate hotel reservations for pairings
l4_steps.input: Approved layover schedule, contracted hotel inventory
l4_steps.output: Hotel confirmation records with room type, check-in/out times
l4_steps.kpi: Auto-booking rate ≥98% for standard layovers; zero manual entry for pairings >48 hrs out
l4_steps.pain_point: API integration gaps with major hotel chain property management systems cause duplicate booking records requiring manual reconciliation 3–4 times per week

l4_steps.name: Book ground transport for crew arrival and departure
l4_steps.input: Hotel confirmation records, scheduled flight arrival/departure times
l4_steps.output: Transport schedule with vendor assignment, vehicle type, and pickup windows
l4_steps.kpi: Transport booking confirmed ≥4 hrs before crew arrival; on-time pickup rate ≥97%
l4_steps.pain_point: Schedule changes within T-2h require emergency vendor calls; dispatch API does not support same-day amendments at 60% of outstations, forcing manual phone coordination

l4_steps.name: Validate hotel transit time vs FAR 117 rest period
l4_steps.input: Hotel address, transport time estimate, crew report time for next leg
l4_steps.output: FAR Part 117 §117.25 compliance flag per crew member
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of layovers validated against FAR Part 117 before booking confirmation
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotels beyond 30-min transport window from airport trigger rest period recalculation under §117.25; legacy hotel contracts predate this requirement and contain non-compliant properties

l4_steps.name: Monitor real-time schedule changes affecting layovers
l4_steps.input: Live flight operations feed, crew schedule update events
l4_steps.output: Change alerts for affected hotel and transport bookings
l4_steps.kpi: Change detection latency <5 min from schedule update event
l4_steps.pain_point: Dec 2022 IROPS demonstrated that cascading schedule changes overwhelm manual monitoring; automated alerting still misses secondary-effect pairings when first-order cancellation triggers re-crewing at a different station

l4_steps.name: Amend hotel and transport bookings for disruptions
l4_steps.input: Change alert with new layover city, arrival time, or cancellation flag
l4_steps.output: Amended or cancelled booking confirmations sent to hotel and transport vendor
l4_steps.kpi: Amendment completion within 30 min of schedule change notification
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel cancellation penalty windows (typically 6-hr cutoff) generate no-show charges when flights cancel <6 hrs out; no automated penalty-waiver negotiation tool exists

l4_steps.name: Push updated crew itinerary to mobile devices
l4_steps.input: Amended booking confirmations, crew contact roster
l4_steps.output: Push notification with hotel name, address, transport pickup time, and confirmation number
l4_steps.kpi: Notification delivery rate ≥99.5%; crew acknowledgement ≥95% within 30 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Crew operating international outstations without cellular data roaming miss push notifications; no fallback SMS gateway for low-connectivity stations is currently integrated

l4_steps.name: Dispatch transport on actual aircraft block-in
l4_steps.input: ACARS actual gate arrival time, crew count from flight manifest
l4_steps.output: Driver dispatch instruction with ETA to gate
l4_steps.kpi: Transport wheels-rolling ≤20 min after block-in; crew at hotel ≤45 min after block-in
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS feed latency at 12% of outstations means dispatch is triggered on estimated rather than actual arrival, causing early driver arrival and standby cost or missed crew if delayed

l4_steps.name: Confirm all crew aboard transport before departure
l4_steps.input: Crew roster for arriving flight, driver headcount check
l4_steps.kpi: Crew accounting accuracy 100% before vehicle departs gate area
l4_steps.pain_point: No electronic crew manifest is scanned at transport boarding; headcount is manual and error-prone, particularly for large widebody arrivals with 12–16 crew members at international stations

l4_steps.name: Source spot-rate hotel for IROPS overflow crew
l4_steps.input: Block gap report, IROPS declaration from Network Operations Control
l4_steps.output: Spot-rate hotel bookings for overflow crew with transport coordination
l4_steps.kpi: Overflow booking confirmed <2 hrs from IROPS declaration; spot rate ≤2.5x contracted rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Current system has no real-time rate cap enforcement for spot bookings; spot-rate hotels during major IROPS events have reached 4x contracted rate with no approval gate, generating significant unplanned cost

l4_steps.name: Reconcile hotel and transport invoices to bookings
l4_steps.input: Vendor invoices, hotel and transport booking confirmation records
l4_steps.output: Matched/unmatched line items and variance report by vendor
l4_steps.kpi: Invoice-to-booking match rate ≥97%; variance items resolved within 10 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Hotel vendors routinely apply early checkout penalties and no-show charges not captured in the booking system, requiring Finance to cross-reference Crew Hotel Management System records manually for every disputed line

l4_steps.name: Generate vendor performance scorecard
l4_steps.input: Matched invoice data, crew feedback submissions, transport on-time records
l4_steps.output: Quarterly vendor scorecard covering cost compliance, service quality, and SLA adherence
l4_steps.kpi: Vendor SLA compliance ≥95%; crew accommodation satisfaction score ≥4.2 / 5.0
l4_steps.pain_point: No structured crew feedback loop exists between hotel stay and vendor management; scores rely on ad-hoc complaints submitted to Crew Control rather than systematic post-stay surveys, understating quality failures
